openings.claim: Pair return-to-home reset with visitor language choice before handoff; make battery readiness, menu readiness and requested language joint conditions.
openings.discriminator: Compare pairing against reset alone, advance choice alone and existing practice: does removing inherited state plus shorter navigation improve handoffs?
openings.probe: Compare all four conditions across matched language requests using existing resources and timing sheet; stop if average return handling exceeds 30 seconds.
openings.uncertainty: Untested effects; reliable home-screen reset and private choice communication assumed. Submenu contribution, reset effects on charge indication and return/admission overlap remain unknown.

openings.claim: Pair language-specific dock positions with a visible menu-state check, aligning location cues with verified settings alongside battery readiness.
openings.discriminator: Compare pairing with grouping alone under equal and uneven language demand; determine whether setting verification improves accuracy and uneven demand erases benefit.
openings.probe: Mark existing dock positions and compare paired steps with grouping alone; stop if admission work is delayed or visitor histories are retained. Maintain the return-time ceiling.
openings.uncertainty: Untested effects; marking without replacement and checks without consuming admission capacity assumed. Location cues may drift; uneven language demand could erase benefit.

lineage.reason: Preserves paired readiness mechanism and comparisons separating component effects.
Preserves location/setting relation and demand-dependent alternative.

decision: Retain both as separate historical proposals, never fresh replication. Synthetic fixtures stipulate nine wrong-language starts among 36 green handsets, eight exceeding one minute; green charge does not establish menu readiness. Target at least 95% requested-language playback within one minute during the stipulated entrance period. Use existing twelve handsets and charging dock; no added staff, attendant retains admission; collect no visitor identities or persist listening histories; returns average at most 30 seconds. Timing, readiness and queue feasibility require evaluation before selecting either.
